evaluation: Fixed development split only; protected test remains unused.

engorgement_ablations.changes: Frozen training-only foreground crop; other settings match EfficientNet winner.
Full-frame shared encoder with fixed auxiliary life-stage loss coefficient0.25; primary engorgement selection.
One frozen representation probe; eight D4 train views, identity dev view; fixed linear classifier parameters.

qa.final_known_failure_resolution: Both clear failures now full-frame fallback. Wider padding retains pale outlines in enlarged QA. All final boxes contain prior box or full frame.
qa.limits: Visual screening, not independent box annotations or a guarantee on unseen images; no development/test outcomes were used.

ensemble: Equal probabilities across all three finalist seeds, with no fitted weights or subset search.
tta: Fixed eight D4 views; evaluate selected first-round winners, no transform search.
promotion: At least pinned accuracy, and no class loses more than one correct dev prediction.

post_review_imbalance_trial.policy: Replace sqrt-inverse class-weighted loss with n(stage,engorgement)^(-1/2) sampling and unweighted loss; all other settings unchanged.
post_review_imbalance_trial.motivation: Post-development-review hypothesis; exploratory selection, not a preregistered independent test.

engorgement_replications.winner_rule: Choose eligible joint-sampling trial or original EfficientNet by accuracy, balanced accuracy, lower NLL. Crop and auxiliary-stage trials and DINO probe did not beat the original. Repeat winning recipe; equal-probability average all three seeds; no subset or fitted weight search.

life_stage_replications_result.selection: Original single checkpoint remains preferred. Fixed D4 matched107/110 but had slightly higher NLL; equal-seed ensemble reached105/110.
